Synopsis:
Gothric Rillyn has been buried underground by Minsc after he tried to rob him. Player can hear muffled yelling from the grave and try to dig him out. This dialogue opens with Gothric having just pulled himself out of the hole (we don't see this in cinematic) and is now dusting himself down.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_BuriedMan.json: Gothric Rillyn has just pulled himself out of a shallow grave after being buried alive — he was muffled and yelling beneath the dirt and the player (or the player’s party) dug him out off‑screen. He admits he tried to steal from a “baldy” (the man who buried him), and he snipes at that man’s self‑styled title “Stone Lord,” even calling him “Stone Shite.” The lines imply the bald man is Minsc, who in other scenes has embraced the Absolute and taken the Stone Lord name, and Gothric keeps his head down until he’s sure Minsc isn’t present in the party. This exchange follows immediately after Gothric dusts himself off and regains his breath.
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_KoboldLooter.json: Automatically initiated dialogue after players bash/prise open a coffin with Bugthimble, a tetchy and mistrustful Kobold, just trying to live her best life looting the coffin and the nasty adventurers dug her upt! She wears a face covering helmet.Players have either dug here expecting to find "Enough valuables to settle matters between us" as the note they found said (Tough letter, found on the Courier by Scratch) or just decided to dig up a grave for fun.
- LOW_CountingHouse_Heist.json: The player finds Rakath Glitterbeard, head banker, and his cronies gathered around a chest congratulating one another on a trap well-sprung. The chest is a mimic, which they've used to capture and kill the crime boss The Stone Lord - or so they believe.The mimic bursts apart from the inside to reveal that the Stone Lord is none other than Minsc - and he's in the thrall of the Absolute. A doppelganger cultist is imitating his old friend Jaheira in an attempt to control him.
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_Gravekeeper.json: A weary gravekeeper, absolutely exhausted at having to bury so many bodies in recent days. Would be good to have her have typical gallows humour, but be relatively kindhearted and helpful underneath it (though relatively unimportant) She will exclusively hang around the gravekeeper's house, and likely either be found sat and resting or just idly milling around a small area.Important topics:- Where you can find a shovel- Killings in Baldur's Gate (with a branch for if it's solved)- (When you've encountered them) Kobold Looters- Something to chastise the player if they've gone around digging up graves themselves, probably a HasMet alt?
- LOW_SharGrotto_SwayedJusticiar.json: A Shar follower in the grotto beneath Baldur's Gate. Reactive one-liner
